planting.note: Direct sow or set out transplants in spring once frost danger has passed; PowWow Wild Berry was bred to flower heavily its first year from seed, so an early start indoors brings bloom on sooner.

directions: PowWow Wild Berry is a 2010 All-America Selections Flower Winner, an Echinacea purpurea strain bred for first-year flowering from seed, producing rich magenta-purple blooms held on a dense, basal-branching habit that avoids the floppy, single-stemmed look of older seed-grown coneflowers. Its compact stature keeps flowers close to the foliage rather than on tall, wind-prone stalks, making it well suited to border fronts and containers. Grow in full sun in lean, well-drained soil, deadheading spent blooms to extend flowering, or leave some seed heads standing into fall for finches.
sources: Chicago Botanic Garden Plant Evaluation Notes

common_name: Secret Lust Coneflower (Double Hot Pink Hybrid Echinacea)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring in well-drained, lean to moderately fertile soil in full sun; Secret Lust is part of a compact, heavily double-flowered breeding line developed to hold its shaggy pompom blooms upright on sturdy stems.

directions: Secret Lust produces fully double, intensely hot-pink to magenta flowers whose shaggy ruff of petaloids all but hides the central cone, giving each bloom a dense, rounded pompom form on a compact, well-branched plant. It belongs to Terra Nova Nurseries' Secret series of double coneflowers, bred for sturdier stems and better flower retention than earlier double Echinacea introductions. Plant in lean, sharply drained soil in full sun, since rich or consistently wet ground shortens the life of double-flowered selections, and divide congested clumps every few years in spring to renew vigor.

common_name: Secret Passion Coneflower (Double Deep Rose Hybrid Echinacea)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring in well-drained, lean to moderately fertile soil in full sun; Secret Passion carries large, fully double, deep rose-red flowers on a compact, well-branched plant.

directions: Secret Passion carries large, fully double flowers in a deep rose-red that darkens toward the center, where a dense cushion of petaloids replaces the usual cone, giving each bloom a saturated color rarely seen in single-flowered coneflowers. Bred by Terra Nova Nurseries as part of its Secret series, it holds its heavy double blooms upright on compact, well-branched stems rather than flopping as many older double selections do. Site it in lean, well-drained soil in full sun, since wet or overly rich ground increases the risk of crown rot in double-flowered Echinacea, and divide crowded clumps every few years in spring to maintain vigor.

common_name: Secret Romance Coneflower (Double Soft Pink Hybrid Echinacea)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring in well-drained, lean to moderately fertile soil in full sun; Secret Romance bears fully double, soft pink flowers on a compact, well-branched plant that needs no staking.

directions: Secret Romance bears fully double, soft pink flowers with a neat, symmetrical pompom of petaloids that fades gently toward the outer guard petals, giving it a softer, more pastel presence than its hot-pink Secret series siblings. The compact, well-branched plant holds its blooms upright through summer without staking. Grow in lean, well-drained soil in full sun, since rich or poorly drained ground shortens the life of double coneflower selections, and divide congested clumps every few years in spring to keep plants vigorous.
